sections.title: Angles & angle chasing
facts: Triangle angles add to $180^\circ$; an exterior angle equals the two far interior angles.
Parallel lines: corresponding and alternate angles are equal; co-interior angles add to $180^\circ$.
Figures are not to scale unless they say so: use only what you are told.

sections.title: Similar triangles
facts: Two equal angles make triangles similar; a parallel cut makes a similar triangle.
Lengths $\times k$: areas $\times k^2$, volumes $\times k^3$.

sections.title: Area
facts: Heron: $s = \frac{a + b + c}{2}$, area $\sqrt{s(s - a)(s - b)(s - c)}$.
Same height: areas compare like bases; a median halves the area.

sections.title: Polygons & angle sums
facts: Angle sum $180(n - 2)$; exterior angles add to $360^\circ$.
